SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(beta3y) as has_3y_beta,
  COUNT(rsquared3y) as has_3y_rsquared,
  COUNT(beta10y) as has_10y_beta,
  COUNT(rsquared10y) as has_10y_rsquared

SELECT 
  f.tickersym,
  ROUND(CAST(r.beta3y AS numeric), 2) as recent_beta_3y,
  ROUND(CAST(r.beta10y AS numeric), 2) as longterm_beta_10y,
  ROUND(CAST((r.beta3y - r.beta10y) AS numeric), 2) as beta_change,
  ROUND(CAST(r.rsquared3y AS numeric), 2) as recent_rsquared_3y,
  ROUND(CAST(r.rsquared10y AS numeric), 2) as longterm_rsquared_10y,
  ROUND(CAST((r.rsquared3y - r.rsquared10y) AS numeric), 2) as rsquared_change,
  CASE 
    WHEN ABS(r.beta3y - r.beta10y) > 0.15 AND ABS(r.rsquared3y - r.rsquared10y) > 10 THEN 'Significant change in both Beta and R-Squared'
    WHEN ABS(r.beta3y - r.beta10y) > 0.15 THEN 'Significant Beta change only'
    WHEN ABS(r.rsquared3y - r.rsquared10y) > 10 THEN 'Significant R-Squared change only'
  END as summary

JOIN funds f ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.beta3y IS NOT NULL 
  AND r.beta10y IS NOT NULL
  AND r.rsquared3y IS NOT NULL 
  AND r.rsquared10y IS NOT NULL
  AND (ABS(r.beta3y - r.beta10y) > 0.15 OR ABS(r.rsquared3y - r.rsquared10y) > 10)
ORDER BY ABS(r.beta3y - r.beta10y) DESC, ABS(r.rsquared3y - r.rsquared10y) DESC;
